---
title: "Running on SLURM"
---

The pipeline up to `koppelen` can be reproduced on an HPC cluster using two scripts:

- `repro.sh` — submits DVC pipeline stages as SLURM jobs with correct dependencies
- `run.sh` — submits isolated Ribasim simulation runs

## repro.sh: pipeline reproduction

Submits the DVC pipeline as individual SLURM jobs. Each authority gets one job that runs its stages in order, and SLURM `--dependency=afterok` ensures correct ordering.

```sh
./repro.sh
```

This submits jobs in these waves:

0. `clean`: removes the outputs of all stages that are run, like `dvc repro` does, and runs `dvc pull --force` for everything upstream of them; no manual pull is needed
1. `rwzi` and `peilbeheer` (shared dependencies)
2. 22 parallel jobs: 11 from `parameterized` to `dynamic`, 10 from `feedback` to `forcing`, and 1 with `hws_demand` and `hws_transient`
3. `samenvoegen` → `koppelen`
4. `commit`: `dvc commit`, `pixi run check` and `dvc push`

It does not run the input-model stages (such as `lumped` and `boezemmodel`), whose outputs `clean` pulls, nor the frozen `bathymetry`, nor the stages after `koppelen`. To also run those, use [`pixi run repro-local`](local.qmd).

The job IDs of `samenvoegen`, `koppelen` and `commit` are written to `repro_jobs.txt` when submitting, for use with `run.sh`.

## run.sh: isolated simulation runs

Copies a model to `/p/ribasim-nl/runs/<name>/` and submits a SLURM job using the named Ribasim core configured in `scripts/install_ribasim_core.py`.

As an immediate preparation step, `run.sh` runs the `archive-core` Pixi task. This task depends on `install-core`, then archives `bin/ribasim` at `/p/ribasim-nl/bin/<NAME>`. Pixi skips the copy when the input directory and installer configuration are unchanged.

Named archives are immutable: `archive-core` does not replace an existing `/p/ribasim-nl/bin/<NAME>` directory. Change `NAME` when archiving a different core.

The submitted SLURM job runs this archived executable, not `bin/ribasim` in the repository. The repository and its installed core can therefore change while simulations are queued or running without changing the executable used by those simulations. The exact Ribasim version is written to each SLURM log before the model starts.

```sh
./run.sh <name> <model_dir> [--after=<jobid>] [key=value ...]
```

TOML overrides use dot notation for nested keys.

### Examples

Run `lhm_coupled` after koppelen finishes:

```sh
./run.sh lhm_coupled data/Rijkswaterstaat/modellen/lhm_coupled \
  --after=$(grep koppelen repro_jobs.txt | cut -f2)
```

Run `lhm_coupled` with a shorter simulation period:

```sh
./run.sh lhm_coupled_1yr data/Rijkswaterstaat/modellen/lhm_coupled \
  --after=$(grep koppelen repro_jobs.txt | cut -f2) \
  endtime="2018-01-01 00:00:00"
```

Compare solver settings:

```sh
./run.sh lhm_coupled_tight data/Rijkswaterstaat/modellen/lhm_coupled \
  --after=$(grep koppelen repro_jobs.txt | cut -f2) \
  solver.abstol=1e-6

./run.sh lhm_coupled_qndf data/Rijkswaterstaat/modellen/lhm_coupled \
  --after=$(grep koppelen repro_jobs.txt | cut -f2) \
  solver.algorithm=QNDF solver.abstol=1e-5
```

All submissions are logged to `/p/ribasim-nl/runs/jobs.txt`. The job logs of `repro.sh` are gitignored.
